posts.preview: Did you know that the Ministry of Justice, Labour and Industrial Relations has an SMS and telephone line for labour-related concerns?
If you belong to a trade union, please contact your union office or officials to attend to your case
As workers, let us have faith in our trade unions. They are strategically established to ensure that workers’ wages, working conditions and employment conditions are improved
Remember, Labour Inspectors have no mandate to negotiate improvements in wages or conditions of employment. That mandate lies with trade unions
